title: SAT Cross-Text Connections: How to Answer Text 1 and Text 2 Questions
description:
"Based on the texts, how would the author of Text 2 most likely respond?" Cross-Text Connections questions give you two short passages and ask how they fit together. This lesson shows you how to sum up each text in one line and name the relationship before you read a single choice.

You'll learn:
• How to spot Cross-Text questions and their most common stems
• A 2-step method: one line per text, then name the relationship
• The 5 relationships: agrees, disagrees, qualifies, extends, explains
• The 4 traps: restating Text 1, too extreme, right relationship but wrong detail, and swapped texts
• 6 paired-passage practice questions, including two where Text 2 only partly agrees

All questions are original SAT-style questions written for this video, not official College Board questions. For official practice, use the free SAT Suite Question Bank (Craft and Structure → Cross-Text Connections).
